positions.thesis: Quality Health Care name in the Market Analyst's top favored sector: F8, gp_sector_pct 0.906, CFO $1,413.5M against net income $1,286.7M, vol 0.330, beta 0.456. It reported 10-29 and the next earnings date is 2027-02-09. No 4.01, 4.02 or 5.02 has been filed since, and the only news is small pipeline items. It overlaps held IDXX in Health Care, but the businesses differ (oncology drugs against animal diagnostics), and the size keeps the bucket near 10.5%. Resized from $17 to $15 for two reasons. The Skeptic is right that the packet has neither the Q3 content nor INCY's own price trend. And the smaller size keeps a cushion over the 10% cash buffer. Single-name biotech risk (trial readouts, regulation) is larger than beta suggests.
positions.invalidation: INCY closes at or below $110.00 (about 10% under the $121.89 close of 11-10; the distance from the actual fill will be restated at the next run), or INCY trails XLV by more than 8 percentage points over a 21-trading-day window, or an 8-K reports a guidance cut or a failed pivotal trial.
